FAQ

Football Jerseys questions

Can sponsor logos go on the shirt?

Yes. Sponsor logos are sublimated with the design, so there is no extra cost per logo.

Do you make matching shorts and socks?

Yes. Most clubs order shirt, shorts and socks as one kit.
